description:
Reclaim is an AI-powered app that creates 40% more time for teams — auto-schedule tasks, habits, meeting & breaks – free on Google Calendar & Outlook Calendar.

Smart Calendar: Automatically finds the best time for tasks. Habit Scheduling: Maintains routines and habits within your workweek. Meeting Syncing: Avoids overlap by syncing multiple calendars. Task Prioritization: Reschedules tasks based on urgency and deadline.
